headline: WNBA Finals Game 3: Dream crush Valkyries 97-71, take 2-1 lead
whyCareReason: Atlanta dominated Game 3 to seize a 2-1 series lead. Angel Reese notched 21 points and 12 rebounds.
teaser: FINAL: Dream 97, Valkyries 71. Angel Reese sets WNBA record with third straight Finals double-double.
story: The Atlanta Dream blew out the Golden State Valkyries 97-71 in Game 3 of the WNBA Finals on Wednesday, 21 October, at State Farm Arena. The victory gives Atlanta a 2-1 lead in the championship series. Angel Reese starred with 21 points, 12 rebounds and three steals, becoming the first player in WNBA history to record a double-double in each of her first three career Finals games. Rhyne Howard added 16 points and Naz Hillmon scored 15 as Atlanta pulled away with a dominant second-half performance. Tiffany Hayes scored 14 points off the bench for Golden State, who shot just 35 percent from the field. Game 4 will be played Friday in Atlanta.
stakes: Atlanta moves one win away from their first WNBA championship in franchise history, holding a 2-1 series advantage heading into Game 4.
rivalryAngle: The Dream defend home court in emphatic fashion after splitting the opening two games in San Francisco.
funFacts: FINAL: Dream 97, Valkyries 71. Atlanta leads series 2-1.
